description: Reads a site's public robots.txt (crawl rules, sitemaps, AI-crawler rules) and security.txt (RFC 9116: contact, expiry, policy), and says whether security.txt is present, current or expired. Missing files are reported as absent, not as errors. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_robots_security_txt
title: Security Robots Security Txt
